subject: hub-registry-audit: unsurfaced metric should model container-surfacing
description:
The 'surfaced on no house page' list counts container CHILDREN (cortex's 13, armory languages, api family, vault children, cloud-master's aws-ccp/aws-developer/azure-fundamentals/az-104/cloud-essentials/openstack, wifi-arsenal) as unsurfaced even though they render inside their container's page by design. Improvement: treat a child as surfaced when its parent is surfaced (or is a verified dynamic hub). Would shrink the 70-item list (post-rollout 2026-07-28) to just the genuinely unreachable set.
[2026-07-29 03:46] SCOPE CORRECTED 2026-07-28 (Nancy). My premise was wrong: I classified the 70 by checking for a  FIELD, not by checking whether the container actually links the child. Two are REAL orphans -- python-graphics (Armory cards it nowhere) and backbone-forensics (Backbone's forensics card points at houses/eye/forensics instead) -- now filed as BUG-046. A 'child inherits its parent's surfaced status' heuristic would have hidden both permanently. Also: the win condition is NOT 70 -> 0. cloud-master is a DYNAMIC hub absent from the static surfaced map, so its 6 children cannot be resolved offline and must stay WARN-unverified, consistent with Part C's existing refusal to assert dynamic existence offline. Honest target: ~8, not 0. THIRD blocker: _app/admin/console.html:4995-5046 independently REIMPLEMENTS this same algorithm client-side for the Hub Health HUD, so fixing only the CLI would make the deploy gate and the admin panel disagree permanently. Fix must either extract shared logic or update both files deliberately.
[2026-07-29 03:46] SCOPE CORRECTED 2026-07-28 (Nancy). My premise was wrong: I classified the 70 by checking for a parent FIELD, not by checking whether the container actually links the child. Two are REAL orphans -- python-graphics (the Armory cards it nowhere) and backbone-forensics (Backbone forensics card points at houses/eye/forensics instead) -- now filed as BUG-046. A child-inherits-parent-surfaced heuristic would have hidden both permanently. Also the win condition is NOT 70 to 0: cloud-master is a DYNAMIC hub absent from the static surfaced map, so its 6 children cannot be resolved offline and must stay WARN-unverified, consistent with Part C refusing to assert dynamic existence offline. Honest target: about 8, not 0. THIRD blocker: _app/admin/console.html lines 4995-5046 independently REIMPLEMENTS this same algorithm client-side for the Hub Health HUD, so fixing only the CLI would make the deploy gate and the admin panel disagree permanently. The fix must extract shared logic or update both files deliberately.
[2026-07-31 11:12] IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-31 (commit above). 70 -> 8, matching Nancy's honest target. Verified the two BUG-046 hubs are NOT falsely rescued: armory now carries href: 'python-graphics/index.html' and backbone's card resolves to /houses/web/backbone/forensics/index.html, both target files exist, and BUG-046 is 'deployed-verified' in the tracker -- so rescuing them is correct, not a heuristic laundering breakage. Added a dead-link guard that FAILS when a container links a child whose page file is missing. Nancy's third blocker handled: admin/console.html reimplemented the same algorithm, so it now splits container members into their own stat labelled 'verify via CLI' rather than counting them unsurfaced -- the browser cannot open container pages, so it states what it knows instead of guessing.
